problem_with_original: None if tenancy is server-enforced; a UI-only workspace would be unsafe
improved_version: Private server-authorized household with explicit membership and field-level privacy
reason: This is the trust and tenancy boundary for every shared capability
evidence: S18 shows the risk of full-access/shared-password family design; S24 shows sensitive food/health data scope
reconsideration_criteria: Never relax isolation; broaden scopes only after threat model and permission tests
alternative_if_not_now: Personal mode until a household is created

problem_with_original: An undefined family model invites child-safety and role sprawl
improved_version: Launch with 2–12 invited authenticated household members; MANAGED_PROFILE is a later non-authenticated managed principal
reason: One membership model supports couples and families without premature child accounts
evidence: S18 documents Cozi up to 12 but with unsafe full access; competitor patterns show multi-person demand
reconsideration_criteria: Expand household size or MANAGED_PROFILE support only after observed need and safety review
alternative_if_not_now: Allow personal workspace before second member joins
owner_note: Do not market child social accounts

problem_with_original: Invite links can be stolen reused or left pending indefinitely
improved_version: Single-use expiring invite with intended role household binding audit and revoke/resend
reason: Household activation depends on low-friction but secure joining
evidence: S02 email matching friction; S10 Apple acceptance/account dependency; S21 Samsung guest view/account-to-edit
reconsideration_criteria: Revisit passwordless/deep-link methods after funnel and abuse data
alternative_if_not_now: In-person QR later; email invite first

problem_with_original: A custom role builder is overengineering; equal access leaks private data
improved_version: Fixed authenticated household roles OWNER/ADULT/MEMBER/GUEST_SHOPPER with server checks; GUEST_SHOPPER expires and is session/list-scoped; MANAGED_PROFILE is a non-authenticated managed principal; PLAN_VIEWER and PLAN_REVIEWER are scoped share principals rather than household roles
reason: Least privilege enables safe removal scoped shopping plan review and private fields without role sprawl
evidence: S18 explicitly documents no restricted access as a negative benchmark; S10 documents participant controls
reconsideration_criteria: Add custom roles only when three recurring capability combinations cannot fit the canonical fixed roles and principals
alternative_if_not_now: Canonical fixed roles and scoped principals
owner_note: GUEST_SHOPPER is the scored A04 fixed-role refinement not an unscored feature; every endpoint and realtime subscription is checked

problem_with_original: Commodity capability is not differentiation
improved_version: One canonical household list with provenance quantities notes assignee and server authority
reason: Necessary substrate for the exception-resolution loop
evidence: S01 S04 S08 S10 S12 S15 S20 document shared-list patterns
reconsideration_criteria: No reconsideration; kill broader OS if reliable two-member list cannot be achieved
owner_note: Do not pitch list alone as moat

problem_with_original: Realtime can imply best-effort UI without ordering reconnect or authorization
improved_version: Authorized ordered events plus snapshot recovery optimistic UI and server-authoritative commit
reason: Two shoppers need convergence not just fast animation
evidence: S01 S04 S08 S15 document instant/realtime expectations
reconsideration_criteria: Transport may change after load measurements; invariants do not
alternative_if_not_now: Short polling only if it passes UX and load budget

problem_with_original: A session can drift into presence or location surveillance
improved_version: Member explicitly starts/ends a time-bounded session with list presence and recovery
reason: Creates useful context for urgent additions and decisions without GPS
evidence: S15 documents Shopping Mode; brief principle rejects continuous tracking
reconsideration_criteria: Add optional store only after consent and observed value; never infer continuous location

problem_with_original: Assignment alone can become stale or imply exclusive ownership
improved_version: Optional assignee plus transient shopper claim/in-cart state and clear release
reason: Separates responsibility from current shopping action
evidence: S10 documents first-class assignment; S08 only a generic star workaround
reconsideration_criteria: Add multi-assignee only if repeated real cases justify it
alternative_if_not_now: Unassigned items visible to all shoppers

problem_with_original: A checkbox can falsely imply confirmed canonical state or permanently erase an item
improved_version: Acknowledged BOUGHT event with undo and retained provenance
reason: Completion is core but must survive retry and concurrency
evidence: S08 S10 S21 document check-off/completion as baseline
reconsideration_criteria: Add receipt verification only after OCR validation; do not gate completion on it
owner_note: Server ack for irreversible downstream effects

problem_with_original: Free text can accidentally hold sensitive data
improved_version: Short item note with respectful copy and household visibility label
reason: Brand size and preference detail prevents wrong purchase
evidence: S02 S04 S08 S11 document notes/details
reconsideration_criteria: Add structured attributes only when note analysis shows repeated patterns and privacy permits
alternative_if_not_now: Quantity brand and allowed-alternative fields where structured
owner_note: Do not index private notes for AI by default

problem_with_original: A single unavailable flag does not resolve what the shopper should do
improved_version: UNAVAILABLE state leading to skip approved substitute or decision request
reason: This is the strongest differentiation observed in the benchmark gap
evidence: No complete structured flow verified in S01–S33; absence is a research gap not proof; founder brief defines need
reconsideration_criteria: Simplify if field study shows household rarely needs consultation
alternative_if_not_now: Skip item or record unavailable without request

problem_with_original: Open-ended discussion is slow and unauditable
improved_version: Bounded options with approve reject choose-one expiry and one canonical resolution
reason: Turns coordination into an actionable decision rather than chat
evidence: Competitive matrix shows shared lists but no verified end-to-end substitution state machine
reconsideration_criteria: Change option set only after observing real in-store choices

problem_with_original: Photos create storage retention metadata and lock-screen privacy risks
improved_version: Optional compressed decision attachment with expiry deletion controls and no default public URL
reason: Visual evidence can resolve brand/size ambiguity quickly
evidence: S02 S04 S08 S11 document item photos; structured alternative-photo decision is not verified
reconsideration_criteria: Retain longer only if users revisit them and privacy review approves

problem_with_original: Generic activity push creates noise and preference violations
improved_version: Decision/item deep link with server-enforced preferences quiet hours dedupe and safe lock-screen copy
reason: Notifications should shorten action time not broadcast every edit
evidence: S04 optional change push; S10 add/complete controls; S17 Cozi event alerts; brief notes existing enforcement gap
reconsideration_criteria: Add notification classes only when action rate and mute rate justify them
owner_note: No launch until backend enforces preferences

problem_with_original: A comprehensive log becomes surveillance and costly retention
improved_version: Minimal consequential audit: membership item resolution plan/share changes with actor and time
reason: Supports trust undo and incident investigation without behavioral monitoring
evidence: S08 shared account and S18 full-access model show attribution weaknesses; brief requires explainability
reconsideration_criteria: Expand event set only for a concrete recovery or trust job; define retention

problem_with_original: A generic calendar broadens scope and competes with mature organizers

reason: Connects household intent to shopping without becoming a family calendar
evidence: S05 S16 S20 S22 document shared meal planning and plan-to-list expectations
reconsideration_criteria: Add monthly horizon only after weekly plan repeats and performs

problem_with_original: Unstructured suggestions become chat and do not converge
improved_version: MealProposal attached to a slot or backlog with proposer and rationale
reason: Lets members contribute without negotiation sprawl
evidence: S20/S22 show collaborative plan edits; no need for generic chat
reconsideration_criteria: Add freeform discussion only if contextual comments cannot resolve observed cases

problem_with_original: Assuming every member attends causes wrong serving and shopping quantities
improved_version: Per-slot yes/no/unknown attendance with explicit default and change cutoff
reason: Attendance is the bridge between coordination servings and shopping
evidence: Founder core loop; competitor sources show shared planning but not household attendance semantics
reconsideration_criteria: Add guest counts after repeated use; no location inference
alternative_if_not_now: Manual serving count if attendance unknown
human_decision_gate: YES: privacy review for visibility defaults

problem_with_original: Voting language implies algorithmic authority and social pressure
improved_version: Lightweight yes/maybe/not-this-week reactions as input to a human confirmation
reason: Low-cost signal supports convergence without opaque ranking
evidence: Founder brief explicitly rejects complex voting without evidence
reconsideration_criteria: Only test ranking if simple reactions repeatedly fail and fairness rules are explainable
alternative_if_not_now: An authorized OWNER or ADULT confirms transparently

problem_with_original: Cross-surface inconsistency and unusable fractions can destroy trust
improved_version: One serving transform covering ingredients nutrition step amounts shopping quantities and attendance under a unit policy
reason: Valuable only after recipe and plan data are structurally reliable
evidence: S06 documents scaling; S27 shows serving-based amounts; brief requires consistency
reconsideration_criteria: Build when representative recipes pass unit/rounding invariants and Meal Board attendance is stable
alternative_if_not_now: Manual serving value with warning; no partial auto-update

problem_with_original: Blind regeneration can delete manual items duplicate ingredients or hide changes
improved_version: Explainable reviewable diff with provenance semantic dedupe and idempotent apply
reason: Plan-to-list is table stakes; integrity and explanation are the differentiation
evidence: S05 S16 S22 S32 document plan/recipe-to-list patterns
reconsideration_criteria: Auto-apply low-risk diffs only after correction and undo data support it

problem_with_original: A live broad share can leak future routines and sensitive preferences
improved_version: Versioned read-only plan snapshot with minimum scope; weekly first; monthly only after use evidence
reason: External visibility can help coordination but is not foundational
evidence: S05 email/print; S22 share plan; S08 revocable scoped links
reconsideration_criteria: Add monthly view when weekly shares are repeatedly used and exposure is acceptable

problem_with_original: Advisor demand is unproven and can create medical expectations and data leakage
improved_version: PLAN_REVIEWER scoped share principal can read comment and propose on a frozen plan snapshot but cannot write canonical state; PLAN_VIEWER is read-only
reason: Potential differentiator but high trust cost and weak MVP evidence
evidence: No reviewed competitor source verifies professional review; brief prohibits medical claims
reconsideration_criteria: At least five pilot households use manual advisor review twice and pay/retain; legal/privacy review passes
alternative_if_not_now: Export a read-only plan or issue a scoped PLAN_VIEWER principal
owner_note: PLAN_VIEWER/PLAN_REVIEWER are scoped share principals not household roles; do not call clinical

problem_with_original: Token security can be underestimated and links can outlive intent
improved_version: Random single-purpose hashed token with expiry scope revoke audit noindex rate limits and PLAN_VIEWER/PLAN_REVIEWER principal scope
reason: Required before any safe unauthenticated external sharing

reconsideration_criteria: No external link without these controls; add renewable links only after audits
alternative_if_not_now: Authenticated household access or a scoped share principal
owner_note: Foundation architecture must reserve PLAN_VIEWER/PLAN_REVIEWER scopes

problem_with_original: Free-floating comments recreate chat and proposals may overwrite state

reason: Context and canonical-state separation keep collaboration actionable
evidence: S28 shows recipe comments but not household workflow; brief principle requires contextual collaboration
reconsideration_criteria: Add mentions/threading only if pilots cannot resolve within one contextual thread

problem_with_original: Generic stars are misleading with tiny samples and can be spammed before cooking
improved_version: Verified Cook Feedback after acknowledged completion: taste difficulty time accuracy cook-again optional note
reason: Creates household memory rather than vanity averages
evidence: S25 documents ratings/photos; brief defines post-cook verification and minimum sample
reconsideration_criteria: Show aggregates only after sample threshold; build when cook completion is trustworthy

problem_with_original: Duplicates A20 and risks separate inconsistent implementations

problem_with_original: Must collect slot attendance servings and target household instead of blind add

evidence: S05 S22 document add-to-plan and plan collaboration

problem_with_original: Missing data may display as zero and medical interpretation/privacy risk is high
